site_name: 3 Neville Terrace, Onslow Gardens, LONDON, SW7 3AT
description: Reconstruction of existing rear conservatory extension in painted metal at raised ground floor level. Modification to rear vault to form WC, enclosing section of rear lightwell and replacing kitchenette window with door. Raise parapet of rear closet wing and install 1No low profile rooflight. New concealed bike/bin storage area with `green' roof. Reconstruct roof as mansard, with flat centre covered in asphalt, front and rear covering in genuine slate, lead covered dormers with genuine box sash windows in painted timber including 1No new low profile rooflights and 1No lantern in painted metal and timber. Renewal of and modifications to railings to rear garden, all in painted metal to match existing pattern. Other modifications to fenestration including replacement French Doors and window to lower ground floor rear bedroom suite. Alterations to internal partitions at second floor level.***WITHDRAWN***
